title: hydrocotyle polystachya var. triradiata
intro: Hydrocotyle polystachya var. triradiata, commonly known as 'Indian Pennywort', is a plant species belonging to the family Araliaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce stress, improve cognitive function, and support overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Indian Pennywort include its ability to modulate the nervous system, enhance memory, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
